verdict.rationale: Telephony bridging is a fair axis for a real-time communications platform, but no evidence item documents SIP trunking, PSTN dial-in, or dial-out for phone callers. WebSocket media adapters that carry PCM audio are developer building blocks, not a telephony bridge, and voice-only RealtimeKit sessions say nothing about phone callers joining.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out
